1479-3861-8338.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2226-2397-6844.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-6844.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4452-5413-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-5413-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

81-116-512.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-116-512.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-116-512.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-6972-8095.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

240-1115-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

104-3188-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3188-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

891-997-1052.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4871-6705-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2933-4499-5798-7297.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5359-7295.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5359-7295.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Graveshifter, adding {C}{C}.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Graveshifter ability from step 2, doing nothing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Graveshifter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

132-1995-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
132-1995-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3652-4053-5686-6989.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5542-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1137-2018-4053.description:
Activate Rith's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{G}{W}.
When Rith's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Rith's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

5231-5660-6690.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sparring Construct, adding {R}.
When Sparring Construct dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sparring Construct from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sparring Construct by paying {1}.
Repeat.

38-2420-6602.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-6602.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Repeat.

650-5231-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
650-5231-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

1690-2538-5034-5645.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Stenn.
1690-2538-5034-5645.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-5034-5645.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2781-4875-5256-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2781-4875-5256-6243.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

38-301-3139.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-3139.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

624-1912-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Phantasmal Image has a power of at least 2.
624-1912-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Phantasmal Image and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Phantasmal Image to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Phantasmal Image by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

579-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
579-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
579-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2146-2866-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1899-2232-2600-3558.description:
Activate Beastcaller Savant by tapping it, adding {G} that can only be spent to cast a creature spell.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Beastcaller Savant by paying {G} due to Bosk Banneret.
When Beastcaller Savant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

703-2896-4284.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attaching Necromancy to Astral Dragon.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Necromancy tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, with at least one trigger targeting Clone.
Resolve the first Necromancy trigger, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Astral Dragon, and not attaching Necromancy to Clone due to Necromancy being a creature.
The Necromancy Aura creature token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to being an Aura that is unattached.
The Necromancy token leaves-the-battlefield ability triggers, as well as Clone's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Necromancy trigger, causing you to sacrifce Clone.
Resolve the Clone trigger, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 4.

112-1367-2114.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara's Oathsworn does not have summoning sickness and has exactly three +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ayara's Oathsworn.
112-1367-2114.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ayara's Oathsworn.
Ayara's Oathsworn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Ayara's Oathsworn and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

225-539-561-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic Mountain, Island or Swamp in library.
225-539-561-5077.description:
Play Maestros Theater.
Maestros Theater enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Resolve the Maestros Theater trigger, causing you to sacrifice it, then search your library for a basic Island, Swamp or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Maestros Theater from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

364-1283-1987-2493.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
